title: The Practice Goal and a Goalie
youtube_title: The Practice Goal and a Goalie | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Willa is just outside the fun, close to a practice goal with no one who wanted to stand in it alone. Delia changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Willa has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
